title: Epaphroditus' Illness and Recovery
description: Paul tells about Epaphroditus, his fellow worker and fellow soldier, who became seriously ill and nearly died while serving Paul on behalf of the church in Philippi. God showed him mercy and healed him, and Paul sends him back to the Philippians so that they may rejoice and welcome him with honor [ref:Phil 2:25-30|Philippians 2:25-30].
